preheader: Anthropic's massive IPO, tech service outages, and major banking shake-ups headline tonight.

lead.headline: Anthropic's IPO Nears as Revenue Surges
lead.body: AI lab Anthropic is poised to price its blockbuster Nasdaq IPO above its initial $70 to $78 range following soaring demand, with order books closing Tuesday afternoon. The massive offering comes as the company reported a staggering 1,127% year-over-year revenue surge to $17 billion in the third quarter.
lead.why: As someone interested in investing and tech markets, watching how a $1.4 trillion valuation target behaves on day one will teach you a lot about how public markets price hyper-growth AI companies.

stories.headline: Disney Cuts $3 Billion in Costs and Drops Streaming Profit Disclosures
stories.body: Disney reported higher fourth-quarter revenue and profits while announcing plans to slash $3 billion in annual operating costs by 2029. The entertainment giant also revealed it will stop reporting operating profits separately for its streaming division.
stories.why: This is a great case study in corporate restructuring and financial transparency for your business strategy classes.

stories.headline: JPMorgan Chase Shakes Up Leadership and Taps New CFO
stories.body: CEO Jamie Dimon has overhauled the bank's leadership for the second time this year, naming investment-bank finance head Bregje de Best as the new chief financial officer. The move follows a resolution to the software glitch that caused widespread transaction delays across online banking earlier this week.
stories.why: Essential context if you are tracking corporate governance and leadership execution in major financial institutions.

stories.headline: California Sues OpenAI Over Safety and Security Safeguards
stories.body: The state of California filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that the ChatGPT maker misled and endangered the public by testing advanced artificial intelligence models without adequate safety guardrails.
stories.why: As an aspiring founder or consultant, regulatory pushback and compliance risk are going to be central design constraints for any AI product you touch.

stories.headline: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Agrees to Congressional Interview
stories.body: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has agreed to appear before three House committees on December 1 following his resignation amid an inquiry into chip sales to China and export compliance.
stories.why: Highlights how geopolitical trade restrictions and executive conduct can completely upend a tech giant's governance overnight.

stories.headline: McKinsey and Cognition Partner to Sell AI Coding Agent Devin to Enterprises
stories.body: Consulting giant McKinsey & Company has teamed up with AI lab Cognition to sell its AI coding agent Devin to large corporations in the US and Europe. McKinsey will advise clients on restructuring engineering teams and workflows around AI tools.
stories.why: A textbook example of how traditional management consulting firms are capturing value by advising enterprises on AI adoption.

stories.headline: McKinsey Report Says Banks Can Generate Nearly 3x Returns on Agentic AI
stories.body: A new McKinsey report states that banks deploying autonomous AI agents could recover their initial investments in about 10 months and generate nearly triple their money over three years.
stories.why: Gives you concrete data points on tech ROI and financial services disruption for your future interviews and consulting case preps.

stories.headline: UC Irvine Junior Crowned Miss Fountain Valley
stories.body: Malia Walker, a junior music theater major at UC Irvine, won the title of Miss Fountain Valley at the Sapphire Center pageant.

stories.headline: Arthur Fils Beats Rafael Jodar at ATP Finals
stories.body: France's Arthur Fils came back from a set down to defeat Spain's Rafael Jodar 4-6, 6-2, 6-2 at the ATP Finals in Turin to keep his semi-final hopes alive.

term.name: Initial Public Offering (IPO)
term.definition: An IPO is when a private company sells shares to the public for the first time to raise capital. Anthropic's upcoming Nasdaq debut highlights how high-growth tech firms use IPOs to scale while letting early investors cash out.

serve.headline: Genesis AI raised $500M at a $3.5B valuation to put Eno robots to work
serve.body: The Paris-based robotics startup secured a massive Series A round co-led by Khosla Ventures, Premji Invest, and Eclipse. The company is building industrial robots designed without heads to automate warehouse and physical tasks.
questions: If you were an investor, how would you evaluate a hardware startup commanding a $3.5 billion valuation at the Series A stage?
How does removing a robot's head change its design efficiency or market appeal?
What operational challenges do you think Genesis AI will face scaling manufacturing in Europe versus the US?
